lines.text: Jehoshaphat prays in the house of the LORD, reminding God He gave the land forever to Abraham's descendants.
The Spirit of the LORD comes on Jahaziel, a Levite, who says the battle belongs to God.
Judah leaves early for the Wilderness of Sinai, and the LORD sets ambushes against the enemy when the singers praise.
Jehoshaphat allies with Ahaziah and builds ships at Joppa, but the ships are wrecked and never sail to Tarshish.
